顾母就站在顾父旁边，听到顾父的声音，也顺着看过去，见真的是自家女儿，脸上也闪过一丝不自在。

“咦，你和顾叔叔顾阿姨认识啊？”娃娃脸男生惊讶的看着时笙，随便救个人还救到了熟人？？

时笙冷笑了一声，“当然认识，他们可是我父母。”

“父母？”既然是父母干嘛用那么生硬和讽刺的语气说话？

“小南，当时你……”

顾母打断顾父的话，脸上的表情又是担忧又是愤怒，“你这死丫头，一天到晚乱跑，这末世来了你知道我们找不到你有多担心吗？”

说到这里，顾母哽咽了起来，声泪俱下，“既然回来就乖乖和我们一起，爸爸和妈妈会保护你的。”

“受不起，我可没有把自家亲生女儿扔下带着别人女儿跑的父母。”想本宝宝陪你们演戏，做梦呢？

顾母是觉得时笙一个人，想要在这末世活下去，肯定得顺着他们说。

剧情中原主也遇到了他们，不过是在去B市的路上。

顾母当时也是这般，说她不懂事一天乱跑，他们找不到她，如何如何伤心，当时原主为了摆脱那几个玷污自己的禽兽，只得生生受着，被周围的人用异样的眼神围观。

可惜她不是顾南。

“怎么回事？”娃娃脸男生有些迷茫，四周的人也纷纷朝着这边看过来。

时笙抢在顾母前面的开口，“末世开始的时候我发烧了，所以我的父母就扔下我，带着我表姐一起跑了。”

“什么？扔下自己的女儿跑了？”

“这种事他们怎么做得出来。”

现在不过末世第六天，除了一些本就是恶贯满盈的人，大部分人还保留着人性，良知。

“你个不孝女，我当初怎么就生了你这个白眼狼，你以前和外面的人鬼混我们管不到你，现在你还这么说我，我这是造的什么孽啊！”

顾母开始哭起来，说得好像真是那么一回事。

一时间大家都不知道该相信谁。

“好了好了，现在活着不容易，你们都是一家人，有什么隔夜仇的不是？现在活着才是最重要的。”

“大家都散了吧，抓紧时间休息。”

之前那个开车的男人让众人散开，他看了时笙一眼，“你的事，等老大和戚小姐回来在说，先休息吧。”

时笙扯着嘴角笑了下，“没什么好说的，我不会认他们的。”

Gu's mother was standing next to Gu's father. When she heard Gu's father's voice, she looked over and saw that it was really her daughter, and a trace of discomfort flashed across her face.

"Hey, do you know Uncle Gu and Aunt Gu?" The baby-faced boy looked at Shi Sheng in surprise. How could he save someone and even an acquaintance??

Shi Sheng sneered, "Of course I know them, they are my parents."

"Parents?" Since they are parents, why do they speak in such a stiff and sarcastic tone?

"Xiaonan, at that time you..."

Gu's mother interrupted Gu's father, the expression on her face was both worried and angry, "You damn girl, you run around all day long. Do you know how worried we are that we can't find you when the end of the world comes?"

At this point, Gu's mother choked up and burst into tears, "Since you are back, just stay with us. Dad and mom will protect you."

"I can't bear it. I'm not the kind of parent who abandons his own daughter and runs away with other people's daughters." What are you dreaming about if I want my baby to act with you?

Gu's mother felt that if Shi Sheng wanted to survive in this apocalyptic world, he must obey their advice.

In the plot, the original owner also met them, but on the way to City B.

Gu's mother was like this at the time, saying that she was ignorant and ran around all day long, and they couldn't find her, so she was so sad. At that time, the original owner had to suffer through life and being looked at with strange eyes by the people around him in order to get rid of those beasts that had defiled him.

It's a pity that she is not Gu Nan.

"What's going on?" The baby-faced boy was a little confused, and people around him also looked over.

Shi Sheng spoke before Gu's mother, "I had a fever when the apocalypse began, so my parents abandoned me and ran away with my cousin."

"What? Abandoned his daughter and ran away?"

"How could they do such a thing?"

It is only the sixth day of the end of the world. Except for some people who are full of evil, most people still retain their humanity and conscience.

"You unfilial daughter, why did I give birth to you, a white-eyed wolf, in the first place? You used to fool around with people outside and we couldn't control you. Now you still say that to me, what kind of evil have I done!"

Gu's mother started to cry and said it as if it was really the case.

For a while, no one knew who to believe.

"Okay, okay, it's not easy to live now. You are all a family. What's the point of having an overnight feud? Living is the most important thing now."

"Everyone, please leave and take some time to rest."

The man who was driving before asked everyone to disperse. He glanced at Shi Sheng and said, "We'll discuss your matters when the boss and Miss Qi come back. Let's rest first."

Shi Sheng smiled and said, "There's nothing to say. I won't recognize them."
